definitions.full: H3501. Yithra יִתְרָא proper name, masculine father of Amasa 2Sam 17:25 (see III. יֶתֶר 3 ).

occurrences.englishText: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
